provenance.note: A supersaw played short: seven saws on the classic uneven detune curve, wide, struck, a filter envelope on every strike, its corner open in the kilohertz and its top past 7 kHz; gritty by distortion and never by a closed filter (a drive, a crush mixed in, a breath of noise). The composer's light (Gleam's upper part) cleans it (the crush leaves, the drive eases) and opens the corner and the top further; its edge (Spark) drives it harder, sharpens the strike and lays one saw an octave over the note at a low blend. A gate chops one held note into strikes.

notes.detune: The outer pair's offset, a fraction of a semitone. The seven sit on an uneven curve: the inner ones near the note, the outer ones far and beating fastest. 0.24 at the dark end, source 10's partials measured ±24 cents (trance-2); `lightDetune` widens it to 0.38 at a full light.
notes.crushMix: The lo-fi grain: a staircase of 2^crushBits levels, mixed in under the dry drive. Gone at a full light.
notes.topHz: The band's top after the grit, 8 kHz at the dark end: the crush's steps rounded off, the saw's buzz kept. The light opens it to 12.8 kHz.
notes.loudnessDb: Declared 0.95 dB over the fixture's -10.05 (the voice suite's tolerance is a decibel): the trim model read the hook 1-2 LU quieter than it plays at the trance corner (the loudness windows of Hard Trance and Trance seeds 1, 2, 5 at -11.3 to -10.9 LUFS against the -13 target, trance-1 round 2), so the trim reads it as it sounds.
notes.hold: 0.85: the gate's chord and the held chord sound to the bar line (one note a tone a bar), the riff's notes legato; read by the loudness model.
